claims: 'You no longer need to pay for AI API keys'; NVIDIA gives free access to 99 of the top models in one place
Creator intro: Stanford founder, AI startup, raised $4 million
how_to_steps: Go to the NVIDIA model catalog site
Click any model, generate an API key

Use the key with the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (code sample shows client.chat.completions.create with base_url integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 and NVIDIA_API_KEY) in Claude Code/Codex, or paste the site URL into Claude/ChatGPT and have it wire up the API
on_screen_only: NVIDIA logo card with partner logos: Kimi AI, DeepSeek, MiniMax, OpenAI, Zhipu AI
Model card 'glm-5-3' with 'Free Endpoint' badge: '753B-parameter text MoE with DeepSeek-style sparse attention, native FP8 weights, reasoning and tool calling', tags 'reasoning' +4

'Prototype — Start building with a free API endpoint' panel with Python snippet (OpenAI client, base_url https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, api_key NVIDIA_API_KEY, messages, temperature, top_p) and 'Specifications' sidebar
cta: Try it and let me know what you build; follow

relevance.why: Free OpenAI-compatible endpoints are handy for prototyping features that call cheaper models (classification, summaries) inside products; not a replacement for Claude in Claude Code.

implement_score.why: Worth a bookmark for prototyping side-tasks with open models at zero cost; free tiers are rate-limited and unsuitable for production, so do not build the business on it.
